definitions.explanation: The baseball fielder who plays between second and third base. {遊撃手|ゆうげきしゅ} is the formal term used in newspapers, official records and broadcasts; in conversation the position is usually called ショート.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遊撃手|ゆうげきしゅ}だ。
{遊撃手|ゆうげきしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{好|こう}⟦プレー→プレー：29432_puree⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: The shortstop made a fine play.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{遊撃手|ゆうげきしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失策|しっさく}→失策：18506_shissaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決勝点|けっしょうてん}→決勝点：31078_kesshouten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}した→許す：02325_yurusu⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}かれていた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The newspaper said the winning run scored on an error by the shortstop.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{遊撃|ゆうげき} (mobile attack, as by a flying column) + {手|しゅ} (player). Box scores abbreviate it to {遊|ゆう}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ショート→ショート：10951_shooto⟧: the everyday name for the position
- {二塁手|にるいしゅ}: second baseman
- {三塁手|さんるいしゅ}: third baseman
